products.description:
Phoenix Outdoor Fire Pits
Made in Ireland
RRP: €275
NOW: €130
*Brand New (Limited Stock)
There’s no such thing as a smokeless firepit, but this comes very close. Designed with secondary air burn holes, secondary air causes the partially combusted gases at the top of the combustion chamber to re-ignite and create a secondary burn flame. This results in greater heat and further reduces the smoke levels emitted from your firepit to a very low level.

products.name: Esse Garden Stove
products.description:
Esse Garden Stove
x1 Remaining Showroom Model
Garden Stove is an outdoor stove with some cooking capability. It comes with wheels to allow it to be easily repositioned or moved after use to protect it from the weather.
Garden Stove has been designed to burn wood and is an outdoor appliance. With the hotplate down it can be used to heat a kettle or pans. Once the wood has burnt down to embers with the hotplate up Garden Stove offers a simple grill.
After use, once it has cooled down and cleaned, it can be moved undercover to protect it from the elements. Treated with flax oil Garden Stove will weather gracefully.
The wheel frame can be detached.
Outdoor heating and cooking
Wheels offer portability
Comes with flue pipe
Simple to assemble simple to use
